# Installing a cluster on {{ ibm_cloud_title }} in a disconnected environment {#installing-ibm-cloud-restricted}

In OpenShift Container Platform 4.22, you can install a cluster in a restricted network by creating an internal mirror of the installation release content that is accessible to an existing Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) on {{ ibm_cloud_name }}.
